Package com.stockroom.service

Class InventoryManager

java.lang.Object
com.stockroom.service.InventoryManager
public class InventoryManager extends Object
Holds every item in the inventory and carries out operations on them.

Items are kept in a LinkedHashMap keyed by ID, so lookups are fast and items keep the order they were added in. IDs start at 1 and go up by one for each new item; they are never reused.

Input is validated with InputValidator before anything changes. After each change, every registered InventoryListener is told (Observer pattern).

When created with an InventoryRepository, the manager can load the stored inventory and saves it automatically after every add, update and delete. A failed save never undoes the change in memory; it is reported through getLastSaveError(), and the next successful save writes everything. Without a repository the manager works purely in memory.

  • Method Details

    • load

      public void load() throws IOException
      Replaces the inventory with the one stored in the repository, then tells the listeners. Does nothing for an in-memory manager.

      Stored items that break the inventory rules are skipped: an invalid name, quantity or threshold, a repeated ID, or a name already used by an earlier item (ignoring case).

      If the repository cannot be read, the inventory is left empty and automatic saving is turned off, so the unreadable data is not overwritten.

      Throws:
      IOException - if the stored inventory cannot be read

    • add

      public Item add(String rawName, String rawQuantity, String rawThreshold) throws InvalidItemException, DuplicateItemException
      Validates raw input and adds a new item with the next free ID.
      Parameters:
      rawName - the item name as typed
      rawQuantity - the quantity as typed
      rawThreshold - the low-stock threshold as typed; blank means the default
      Returns:
      the newly added item
      Throws:
      InvalidItemException - if any field fails validation
      DuplicateItemException - if another item already has this name, ignoring case

    • updateItem

      public Item updateItem(int id, String rawName, String rawQuantity, String rawThreshold) throws ItemNotFoundException, InvalidItemException, DuplicateItemException
      Validates raw input and replaces the name, quantity and threshold of an existing item. Keeping the item's own name, even with different letter case, is allowed.

      Nothing changes unless every field is valid.

      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the item to update
      rawName - the new item name as typed
      rawQuantity - the new quantity as typed
      rawThreshold - the new low-stock threshold as typed; blank means the default
      Returns:
      the updated item
      Throws:
      ItemNotFoundException - if no item has this ID
      InvalidItemException - if any field fails validation
      DuplicateItemException - if a different item already has this name, ignoring case
